sources: https://web.archive.org/ (2023 snapshots of discontinued orvis.com product pages)
explainer: Orvis sells its own lines in three tiers. PRO ($98 smooth / $129 textured) is the top tier: 'advanced compound' multi-segment tapers, AST Plus slickness, and a three-color layout (8' stealth tip, 30' mark, rear taper/running line); most PRO tapers come in a micro-textured version that floats higher and shoots farther, and PRO Power Taper is built a half size heavy for fast rods. Hydros ($79, made in USA) is the mid tier: smooth AST-coated two-color lines with a color change at 30', each tuned to one job — Trout (all-round), Superfine (1-5 wt presentation), Double Taper, Tactical Nymph (Euro), Salmon/Steelhead (very long head), Bank Shot (short heavy heads, float or 7 ips sink tip) and Saltwater / Big Game.

Clearwater ($49) is the budget line: one half-size-heavy WF taper with a front loop only, aimed at beginners. Encounter appears on orvis.com only as a line bundled in Encounter rod outfits, not as a separate line (our reading of the site search). Orvis's own taper charts show what differs: PRO Trout has a long 25-29' multi-stage front taper into a 50' head, while Hydros Trout has a short ~5' front taper and a long belly (45-50' head); the saltwater lines differ by core (mono for tropical, multifilament for cool water).

Choosing: pick by the job first (trout, Euro nymph, bank streamer, salt); then pick PRO for the best coating/taper (textured if you want float and shoot, Power Taper for fast rods), Hydros for a cheaper US-made specialist, or Clearwater on a budget. Inference from 2023 archive snapshots: Orvis has since dropped the smooth versions of PRO Power Taper and the PRO saltwater lines, the PRO Ignitor, and several Hydros lines (Nymph, Warmwater, Cold Water/Tropic Intermediate, Bank Shot Intermediate); these are kept here as discontinued.
Orvis also resells Scientific Anglers lines, which are excluded.
omitted: Encounter fly line (sold only inside Encounter rod outfits)
